message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "Wikinews has confirmed that the loosely defined online activist group Anonymous initiated a coordinated cyber-attack campaign, dubbed 'Operation Baylout,' targeting the digital infrastructure of organizations prosecuting The Pirate Bay. This decentralized operation involves hundreds of volunteers jamming the websites of the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry and the law firm MAQS, while also attempting to disrupt the fax lines of the MPAA's anti-piracy office and prosecuting attorney Monique Wadsted."}
